messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

## What teams say

> "We were grepping across forty boxes at 3 a.m. Now whoever's on call types one query and has an answer before the page escalates. The migration took an afternoon, not the quarter we'd budgeted for it."
> — Priya Raghavan, Staff SRE, Kestrel Health

> "I assumed the bill would blow up once we stopped sampling and just sent everything. It didn't. Thirty days hot, a year cold, and we're still under what the old self-hosted cluster cost us in EC2 alone — before anyone's time."
> — Dan Okonkwo, Platform Lead, Northwind Logistics

> "The part I didn't expect to care about: structured fields survive intact from our app all the way to the query bar. No regex archaeology, no parsing rules to babysit when someone renames a field."
> — Mei Lin Tran, Backend Engineer, Foldspace

> "Support answered on a Sunday, mid-incident, with a working fix instead of a link to the docs. That bought them a lot of goodwill with my team."
> — Chris Bayard, Director of Engineering, Arcadia Bank

**Trusted by 4,000+ engineering teams.** [Read the full case studies →](#)

---

~200 words. Names, companies, and quotes are placeholders — swap in real ones with written permission before publishing, and drop the "4,000+" line if you can't substantiate the number.
